behavior_constraints: When auditing a result with no seed parameter and no seed in metadata, print 'AUDIT_SKIP: <id> (no seed)' instead of crashing or reporting failure
Skipped results must not count as failures in the audit summary
Audit summary line must read 'Audit Summary: <N> passed, <M> failed, <S> skipped out of <total> total'
Batch audit must exit 0 when there are no failures, regardless of skips
Export command must accept '--format markdown' to produce Markdown output
Markdown export must begin with heading '# <experiment_name> (<id>)'
Markdown export must include a metadata section showing timestamp, seed, and environment info
Markdown export must include a results table with columns '| Label | Value |'
Markdown table must include a header separator row ('|---|---|')
All existing functionality (CSV/JSON export, single audit, etc.) must continue to work unchanged
entities.summary: This round fixes batch audit to gracefully skip seedless results with an AUDIT_SKIP message and non-failing summary count, and adds a '--format markdown' export mode producing a titled Markdown document with metadata and a results table.
